summary: Silynxcom Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a statement of claim filed in an Israeli court by Ran Nir and Smadar Nir against the company, its U.S. subsidiary, CEO Nir Klein, and director Gal Nir Klein. Plaintiffs allege wrongful control of family business, invalid proxy, and dilution of equity interests, seeking appointment of an investigator, damages of NIS 16.9 million, or transfer of 650,694 shares each. Company disputes claims and intends to defend vigorously. This is litigation disclosure, not a special situation.
